name: absolutecinema
description: AbsoluteCinema VoD platform - root script runner

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.db:setup: npm run docker:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed && npm --prefix backend run videos:generate
scripts.predev: npm run docker:up && npm run db:migrate
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
